notes: LAN matches now let the host pick the board, border mode, blast threshold, win condition and the algorithm for each AI, savable as presets; new IPv6 cross-network play; the in-game ranking defaults to ML score, with a rating chart and most valuable move on the result screen; undo now jumps back to the previous human player; fixed wrong back navigation on sub-pages and a missing ML rating chart at settlement
notes_zh: 新增局域网联机规则自定义（房主选棋盘、边界、阈值、胜负判定、每个 AI 的算法，可存多套预设）与 IPv6 跨网络联机；局内排名默认按 ML 评分，结算新增评分曲线和最具价值一步；悔棋自动退回上一位真人；修复二级页返回错乱与结算评分缺失
